# T-2: Surface retry recovery state

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Expose retry exhausted and recovery possible/impossible state through next-action and status so the user can see the stop reason and recovery command.

## Acceptance Criteria
- next-action includes recoveryPossible, recoveryReason, recoveryCommand, kind, phase, canonicalPhase, attempts, max, and changedEvidence for exhausted active retry phases.
- status includes the same recovery summary for active exhausted states.
- Unsupported plan gates and unchanged exhausted states explain why recovery is not available.

## Implementation Notes
Owns get-next-action/get-status view composition plus any helper shared with gate/review stop views. Reuse existing reviewStop shape where possible.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for next-action/status output across eligible and ineligible exhausted states.
